_about: Lines for scripts/multilang_check.py. Per language: B's display name, B's new friend (native spelling used in the lines, plus other spellings: Latin ones are what the ASR keywords and the English caption check use), call 1 (B introduces the friend) and call 2 (B mentions the friend again). gloss is the English meaning for a reviewer; the check never sends it.

a_line.text: My friend Mei and I went hiking last weekend.
a_line.gloss: A's own news, naming A's friend Mei (planted as A's friend from college).

call1.text: Oye, en el club de escalada conocí a una chica que se llama Lucía, y ahora entrenamos juntas los sábados.
call1.gloss: Hey, at the climbing club I met a girl called Lucía, and now we train together on Saturdays.

call2.text: Ayer fui a escalar otra vez con Lucía y por fin terminé una vía bien difícil.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went climbing with Lucía again and I finally finished a really hard route.

call1.text: Au fait, j'ai rencontré une fille super sympa au cours de poterie, elle s'appelle Camille.
call1.gloss: By the way, I met a really nice girl at pottery class, her name is Camille.

call2.text: Samedi, Camille et moi, on a refait de la poterie, et j'ai enfin réussi un bol.
call2.gloss: On Saturday Camille and I did pottery again, and I finally managed a bowl.

call1.text: Ich hab im Chor eine neue Freundin gefunden, sie heißt Lena und singt total schön.
call1.gloss: I found a new friend in the choir, her name is Lena and she sings really beautifully.

call2.text: Gestern war ich nach der Probe noch mit Lena was trinken.
call2.gloss: Yesterday after rehearsal I went for a drink with Lena.

call1.text: Ah, fiz uma amiga nova na aula de dança, o nome dela é Mariana.
call1.gloss: Oh, I made a new friend at dance class, her name is Mariana.

call2.text: Ontem eu e a Mariana fomos dançar forró até tarde.
call2.gloss: Yesterday Mariana and I went dancing forro until late.

call1.text: Sai, al corso di cucina ho conosciuto una ragazza simpaticissima, si chiama Giulia.
call1.gloss: You know, at the cooking class I met a super nice girl, her name is Giulia.

call2.text: Domenica Giulia mi ha insegnato a fare la pasta fresca a casa sua.
call2.gloss: On Sunday Giulia taught me how to make fresh pasta at her place.

call1.text: Ik heb bij de hardloopclub een nieuwe vriendin leren kennen, ze heet Sanne.
call1.gloss: I got to know a new friend at the running club, her name is Sanne.

call2.text: Zondag hebben Sanne en ik samen tien kilometer gelopen.
call2.gloss: On Sunday Sanne and I ran ten kilometers together.

call1.text: Słuchaj, na ściance wspinaczkowej poznałam fajną dziewczynę, ma na imię Kasia.
call1.gloss: Listen, at the climbing wall I met a cool girl, her name is Kasia.

call2.text: Wczoraj znowu byłam z Kasią na ściance i w końcu weszłam na samą górę.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I was at the wall with Kasia again (instrumental Kasią) and finally made it to the top.

call1.text: Bu arada, basketbol kursunda Mehmet diye biriyle tanıştım, çok iyi anlaşıyoruz.
call1.gloss: By the way, at the basketball course I met someone called Mehmet, we get along really well.

call2.text: Dün akşam Mehmet'le yine basket oynadık, beni fena yendi.
call2.gloss: Last night Mehmet and I played basketball again, he beat me badly.

call1.text: Eh, aku punya teman baru dari kelas yoga, namanya Rina.
call1.gloss: Hey, I have a new friend from yoga class, her name is Rina.

call2.text: Kemarin aku sama Rina yoga bareng di taman.
call2.gloss: Yesterday Rina and I did yoga together in the park.

call1.text: Eh, aku dapat kawan baru kat kelas badminton, nama dia Aisyah.
call1.gloss: Hey, I made a new friend at badminton class, her name is Aisyah.

call2.text: Semalam aku main badminton dengan Aisyah sampai pukul sepuluh.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I played badminton with Aisyah until ten o'clock.

call1.text: Uy, may bago akong kaibigan sa volleyball, si Bea.
call1.gloss: Hey, I have a new friend from volleyball, Bea.

call2.text: Kahapon nag-practice ulit kami ni Bea hanggang gabi.
call2.gloss: Yesterday Bea and I practiced again until nighttime.

call1.text: À, mình mới quen một bạn ở câu lạc bộ cầu lông, tên là Trang.
call1.gloss: Oh, I just got to know a friend at the badminton club, her name is Trang.

call2.text: Hôm qua mình với Trang đi đánh cầu lông tới tối luôn.
call2.gloss: Yesterday Trang and I went to play badminton until evening.

call1.text: अरे, मेरी डांस क्लास में एक नई दोस्त बनी है, उसका नाम प्रियंका है।
call1.gloss: Hey, I made a new friend in my dance class, her name is Priyanka.

call2.text: कल मैं और प्रियंका डांस की प्रैक्टिस करने गए थे।
call2.gloss: Yesterday Priyanka and I went to practice dance.

call1.text: জানো, গানের ক্লাসে আমার একটা নতুন বন্ধু হয়েছে, ওর নাম তানিয়া।
call1.gloss: You know, I made a new friend in singing class, her name is Tania.

call2.text: কাল তানিয়ার সাথে গানের রিহার্সালে গিয়েছিলাম।
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went to singing rehearsal with Tania (genitive tania-r before 'with').

call1.text: تعرفت على صديقة جديدة في نادي السباحة، اسمها ليلى.
call1.gloss: I met a new friend at the swimming club, her name is Layla.

call2.text: أمس رحت أسبح مع ليلى بعد الشغل.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went swimming with Layla after work.

call1.text: הכרתי חברה חדשה בחוג קרמיקה, קוראים לה נועה.
call1.gloss: I met a new friend in the ceramics class, her name is Noa.

call2.text: אתמול הלכתי עם נועה לים אחרי העבודה.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went to the beach with Noa after work.

call1.text: そういえば、ボルダリングジムで由紀ちゃんっていう友達ができたんだ。
call1.gloss: Oh right, I made a friend called Yuki at the bouldering gym.

call2.text: 昨日も由紀ちゃんと一緒にジムで登ってきたよ。
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went climbing at the gym with Yuki again.

call1.text: 아 맞다, 나 요가 학원에서 친구 생겼어. 이름은 지우야.
call1.gloss: Oh right, I made a friend at my yoga studio. Her name is Ji-woo.

call2.text: 어제 요가 끝나고 지우랑 같이 떡볶이 먹었어.
call2.gloss: Yesterday after yoga Ji-woo and I had tteokbokki together (particle -rang attached).

call1.text: 对了，我在羽毛球社认识了一个新朋友，叫思琪。
call1.gloss: Oh right, I met a new friend at the badminton club, her name is Siqi.

call2.text: 昨天我又跟思琪一起去打羽毛球了。
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went to play badminton with Siqi again.

call1.text: นี่ เราได้เพื่อนใหม่จากคลาสทำอาหาร ชื่อมิ้นท์
call1.gloss: Hey, I made a new friend from cooking class, her name is Mint.

call2.text: เมื่อวานเราไปทำขนมกับมิ้นท์ที่บ้านเขามา
call2.gloss: Yesterday I went to make desserts with Mint at her place (no spaces between words).

call1.text: தெரியுமா, என் டான்ஸ் கிளாஸ்ல புதுசா ஒரு ஃப்ரெண்ட் கிடைச்சிருக்கா, அவ பேரு திவ்யா.
call1.gloss: You know, I've got a new friend in my dance class, her name is Divya.

call2.text: நேத்து திவ்யா கூட சேர்ந்து டான்ஸ் ப்ராக்டிஸ் பண்ணேன்.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I practiced dance together with Divya.

call1.text: ಗೊತ್ತಾ, ನನ್ನ ಯೋಗ ಕ್ಲಾಸಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬಳು ಹೊಸ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ದಾಳೆ, ಅವಳ ಹೆಸರು ಅನನ್ಯಾ.
call1.gloss: You know, I've got a new friend in my yoga class, her name is Ananya.

call2.text: ನಿನ್ನೆ ಯೋಗ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅನನ್ಯಾ ಜೊತೆ ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿಯೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೆ.
call2.gloss: Yesterday after yoga I went for coffee with Ananya.

call1.text: తెలుసా, నా డాన్స్ క్లాసులో కొత్త ఫ్రెండ్ దొరికింది, తన పేరు హారిక.
call1.gloss: You know, I got a new friend in my dance class, her name is Harika.

call2.text: నిన్న హారికతో కలిసి డాన్స్ ప్రాక్టీస్ చేశాను.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I practiced dance together with Harika (-tho 'with' attached).

call1.text: माहितीये, माझ्या गाण्याच्या क्लासमध्ये एक नवीन मैत्रीण झालीये, तिचं नाव सायली.
call1.gloss: You know, I made a new friend in my singing class, her name is Sayali.

call2.text: काल मी सायलीबरोबर गाण्याचा सराव केला.
call2.gloss: Yesterday I practiced singing with Sayali (-barobar 'with' attached).
